instruction: Extract the text from all slides of the presentation and save it in a document named "presentation.docx" on the Desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey("ctrl", "s"); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires extracting all text from PowerPoint to Word document. Evaluator verifies document has sufficient lines with partial credit: minimum 35 lines (0.5 score), target 47 lines (1.0 score). Verified ground truth has 47 non-empty paragraphs. Partial credit allows for minor variations in extraction.
